description: Narrative strength of an entity: its eigenvector centrality in the BCA co-mention graph over 7d, 30d or 90d, a gauge of whether its narrative is consolidating or fading. Unseeded when the entity is absent from the window's graph. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
name: get_narrative_strength
